scope: Adultos propostos acima de B e C jovens aprovadas, sem integração.

specs.name: Adulto de B — Porto vivo
specs.detail: B ADULT: develop the young current-blocker into an imposing LIVING HARBOR, quadrupedal and architectural but unmistakably alive. Transform the squat spherical torso into a high forward chest with compact tapering hindquarters, four thick webbed anchoring legs, near front leg planted ahead. Head small in relation to body with extended blunt mature muzzle, no helmet. The young single chest crescent becomes TWO huge continuous folded lateral breakwater surfaces rooted from collar and ribs. They sweep outward then curve protectively rearward like the two sides of an open boat, with a clearly visible sheltered negative space between them behind the neck. Do NOT enclose an extra animal, no building miniature. Ivory inner surfaces, petrol outer folds, mint rim. One side open a little to show folding mechanism at rib joint. Bamboo edge spar grows along each membrane and coral knotted flexible rib root is visible. Low rear keel rather than giant dorsal sail. Massive guardian posture, asymmetry of one deployed and one partly folded side; whole silhouette wider and more angular than young. No human hands, no shell turtle, no boat prop worn on body. Warm powerful wise aquatic adult.
specs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original Soulmonsters ADULT evolution, not a bigger young and not a knight suit. Attached OWN approved YOUNG design is ancestry reference, not target anatomy. 45% living creature /45% functional living kite /10% clean manga with selective pixel-stepped dark contours. Fullbody threequarter hero concept on pure white with ample margin, no text or extra characters. Strong precise manga linework, flat vivid mint/ivory/deep petrol/coral/gold colors, one crisp shadow tone, broad restful planes, no gradient, glossy plastic, painting, noise, fur, triangular tessellation, ornate tiny patterns. Mature capybara-derived head with long blunt muzzle, small round ears, SMALL narrow attentive eyes, confident composed expression and ivory muzzle. Not cute round childish face, not snarling evil. Living tension-paper body organized by folds and curved bamboo edge spars, sparse coral knots, paper anatomy not mammal wearing accessories. All limbs have distinct roots; body functioning must be visible without effects. Complete soul-bearing rabiola from pelvis via continuous cord and THREE diamond tabs, not cropped. Preserve mint/ivory current motif selectively; deep petrol becomes dominant to mark maturity, mint folded leading surfaces, warm ivory structural interior, coral small accents. Do not reproduce references from any other franchise. No armor, metal, external handheld weapons, staff, humanoid clothing, castles, buildings or scenery.

specs.name: Adulto de C — Tecelão de correntes
specs.detail: C ADULT: RADICAL anatomical maturation of the paddle-armed young into an elegant semi-upright LIVING SLUICE/WEAVER OF CURRENTS. Tall deep-petrol capybara-derived animal torso with lifted slender neck and small mature tapered blunt capybara head. Two powerful digitigrade rear legs ending in long spread webbed feet, two forelimbs total. Forelimbs themselves become long supple S-curved tension-paper limbs broadening continuously into large fan-shaped folded fins: a single anatomical system from shoulder through elbow into broad ivory/mint fin, NO hands gripping or tied to separate paddles, NO cuff-mounted canoe props. Fine gold curved spars are anatomical leading bones/edges, two visible coral knotted elbow articulations. One broad forelimb-fin unfurls forward like a descending watergate; other folds close along the flank, revealing how it retracts. Folded ventral membrane between hips forms a short split-keel silhouette, not clothing skirt; child dorsal sail absorbed into small folded collar and limb leading edges. Graceful decisive contrapposto in a grounded adult pose, not generic fighter ready fists. Whole animal looks sovereign and precise, long diagonal negative spaces and clear arm roots. Three diamond soul-tail tabs trail behind on single cord. At most two small flat blue-green water arcs under the active fin, no big aura hiding anatomy.
